vulnerabilities.title: Missing Security Headers (No Helmet)
vulnerabilities.remediation: Use helmet middleware: app.use(helmet()) to set security headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, etc.).

vulnerabilities.title: Insecure Random Number Generator
vulnerabilities.remediation: Use crypto.randomBytes() or crypto.randomUUID() for security-sensitive operations.

vulnerabilities.title: Missing Authentication on Sensitive Route: /dashboard
vulnerabilities.codeSnippet: router.get('/dashboard', vuln_controller.dashboard_get);
vulnerabilities.remediation: Add authentication middleware to sensitive routes. Use passport.js, express-jwt, or similar.

vulnerabilities.title: Command Injection
vulnerabilities.remediation: Avoid exec/execSync with user input. Use execFile with an argument array instead. Validate and whitelist allowed commands.

vulnerabilities.title: Reflected XSS - User Input in Response
vulnerabilities.remediation: Sanitize or encode user input before including it in HTTP responses. Use a templating engine with auto-escaping.

vulnerabilities.title: Unsafe Deserialization
vulnerabilities.remediation: Avoid deserializing untrusted data. Use JSON.parse() instead. For YAML, use yaml.safeLoad().
